2. Preference and Choice

Foundations of rational choice — from the axioms of preference relations to choice rules and WARP.

  • Preference Relations and Axioms — See preferences on the 2-good plane. Switching the utility family redraws the indifference map, and two bundles A, B are ranked instantly. Watch what breaks when completeness or transitivity fails.
  • Choice Rules and WARP — Pick bundles yourself in two budget situations. If each situation could have afforded the other’s choice — that violates the Weak Axiom of Revealed Preference (WARP).
